first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The boxy taxi that is continuously followed, identifiable by its red body, beige illuminated roof, light-colored side panels, and white roof light.

entities.name: longitudinal main road
entities.identification: The gray-brown multilane road surface extending through the frame, with visible white dashed lines, yellow crosswalk stripes, and road-surface seams.

entities.name: line of roadside vehicles on the right
entities.identification: The set of background vehicles arranged longitudinally along the curb on the right, excluding Vehicle A, Vehicle C, and Vehicle D.

entities.name: building facades along the street
entities.identification: The partially visible pinkish-brown vertical wall surface at the right edge, with dark openings and projecting horizontal components.

entities.name: roadside sidewalk
entities.identification: The long, narrow pedestrian pavement extending along the curb on the left side of the road, partially affected by cyan-blue illumination.

entities.name: Vehicle C
entities.identification: The low blue-gray sedan in the lane to the image-left of Vehicle A, with a dark rear window, yellow rear plate, and curved taillights.

entities.name: Vehicle D
entities.identification: The light-colored, boxy van in the lane on the left, with a warm-yellow illuminated roof, dark rectangular rear window, and yellow rear plate.

entities.name: road sign with a white arrow on a blue background
entities.identification: The blue road sign on the right side of the road, with a white arrow pointing toward the top of the sign face.
